out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the handwashing sink at the cookline.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. Paper towels replaced.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap dispenser in poor repair at the handwashing sink located by the dishwashing area.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. Soap provided at handsink.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: vodka sauce observed in steam well at 120F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Vodka sauce reheated to 165F.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Large vat of pizza sauce (64F) observed in walk in cooler. Portioned sliced chicken (51F) observed in 2 Dr pizza prep.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Chicken discarded. Pizza sauce is constantly moved out of walk in cooler for refilling portions or catering orders. EHS recommended utilizing ice wands or smaller portioning to better hold pizza sauce temperature.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: -Pizza sauce in walk in cooler observed at 50F. PIC stated pizza sauce was pulled out of walk in cooler for a catering order. -Sliced ham observed over stacked in 2 Dr pizza prep at 50F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. -Pizza sauce moved to freezer unit to cool down. -Ham to be utilized within next hours.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Large batch of pizza sauce observed at 47F in walk in cooler. PIC stated pizza sauce was pulled out of walk in cooler to refill at stations.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. -please ensure pizza sauce is cooled and maintained at 41F or below.
